**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/26 (Fri) 20:15
- [FACT] User's name is Jacob.
- [EVENT] Jacob has a dream about a council meeting of spirits.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] In the first dream scene, Jacob sees a nearly infinite room filled with an uncountable number of spirits in pairs discussing something, which he realizes is a council meeting.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Jacob feels overwhelmed by the collective power of the spirits in the room.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Jacob searches for Eri and Racita among the spirits.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Jacob finally finds Eri and Racita, who are focused and determined, and they discuss the council meeting's purpose.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Eri tells Jacob that they gather to discuss the state of the universes and keep everything in balance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Racita reassures Jacob that he will learn and understand in time.
- [EVENT] Jacob has another dream of the spirits holding a council meeting with tension in the air.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] In the second dream scene, Jacob hears the name "Lorelei" and other names of evil spirits, sensing the spirits are anxious and angry.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Jacob struggles to stay conscious and understand the discussions happening around him.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Jacob sees spirits of various shapes and sizes, including one with feathers for hair, another with skin made of crystal, and one with tentacles for arms.
- [EVENT] Jacob finally finds Eri and Racita in the dream, and they look alarmed to see him.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Eri expresses concern for Jacob's presence in the council meeting.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Racita tells Jacob that he should not be there and that it is not safe for him.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Jacob asks what is going on, and Racita explains that it is a council meeting discussing serious matters.
- [EVENT] Jacob wakes up from the dream feeling shaken.
- [EVENT] Jacob goes to the shrine to the village guardians to pray.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Racita appears to Jacob at the shrine, expressing concern for him.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Jacob begs Racita to tell him what is going on.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Racita explains that Lorelei is a rogue spirit seeking chaos and destruction, and the council is discussing how to contain her.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Racita tells Jacob that he can help by continuing to pray and believe in the goodness of the universe.
- [EVENT] Racita disappears in a bright flash of light after their conversation.
